DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の担当は、朝礼の後に班長が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-01.translation: The team leader will explain today's assignments after the morning meeting.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 掲示に北側広場とあったので、工具を持ってそこで作業を始めようと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 避難掲示の場所で作業を始めようとしたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-02.translation: The notice said ‘north plaza,’ so I was going to take my tools there and start working.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you were going to begin work at the place on the evacuation notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 北側広場は、この掲示では避難時の集合場所です。今日の作業場所の指定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this notice, the north plaza is the evacuation assembly point. It doesn't specify today's work location.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見出しを読まず場所だけ見ていました。まだ工具は運んでいません。今日の担当は班長に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未搬入を報告し見出しの取り違いを修正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-04.translation: I looked only at the place without reading the heading. I haven't carried the tools there yet. I'll check today's assignment with the team leader.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report that you have not moved the tools and correct the misunderstanding of the heading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。避難場所も覚えておいてください。作業先とは別に案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Remember the evacuation point too. We'll explain it separately from the work location.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 避難場所へ行く経路も、資材運搬の経路と同じだと決めず確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 避難経路と資材運搬経路を別に確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd also like to check the route to the evacuation point without assuming it's the same as the materials-transport route.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the evacuation and material-transport routes separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当日の通行状況を含めて担当が説明します。説明後は班に合流してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain, including today's access conditions. Join your team afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 班名が似ていて間違えそうです。自分が入る班の名前と班長を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 所属班名と班長の特定を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-08.translation: The team names are similar, so I might confuse them. Could you tell me the name of my team and its leader?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to identify your team name and leader. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この班です。班長を呼びますので、工具は決められた置場に残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is your team. I'll call the leader, so leave your tools in the designated storage place.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。班長から作業場所と役割を聞き、避難経路の説明も受けてから工具を運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当と避難経路の説明後に工具を運ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll hear the work location and my role from the leader and receive the evacuation-route explanation before moving the tools.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will move the tools after hearing the assignment and evacuation-route explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順で確認しましょう。掲示だけを見て作業は始めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check in that order. Don't begin work based only on the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 症状は昨日からと記入されていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've written that the symptoms started yesterday.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日は初めて相談した日です。実際には先週から、時々同じ症状がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記入した昨日は初回相談日だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday was the first day I asked for advice. Actually, I've had the same symptoms occasionally since last week.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the entry by explaining that yesterday was your first consultation date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 始まった日と、相談した日は違うのですね。先週の何曜日か覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the starting date and consultation date differ. Do you remember which day of last week?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 曜日は確かではありません。最初に気付いたのは休日の朝で、勤務を休んだ日とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発症曜日は不確かで休日の朝に気付いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm not sure of the weekday. I first noticed it on a morning when I was off work, which was different from the day I took leave from work.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the weekday of onset is uncertain and you noticed it on the morning of a day off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確かでない日は断定せず、その範囲で記録しましょう。毎日続いていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than assert an uncertain date, let's record what you know. Was it continuing every day?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毎日ではありません。間に症状のない日もあるので、先週からずっと続いたとは書かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連日継続でなく症状のない日もあったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not every day. There were symptom-free days in between, so please don't write that it continued nonstop from last week.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that it did not continue daily and there were symptom-free days. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 症状のあった日が分かるメモはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have notes showing which days you had symptoms?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二日分だけ携帯に残っています。その二日が全部だとは言えませんが、診察で見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二日分の記録は経過全体ではないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only two days are recorded on my phone. I can't say those were all the days, but I'd like to show them during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the two recorded days do not represent the entire course. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録のある日と、記憶だけの日を分けて担当者へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll distinguish the recorded days from those you only remember when telling the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。昨日の相談日を発症日として扱わず、時々あったこととメモの範囲を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発症と相談と記録範囲を分けて引継ぎを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Rather than treat yesterday's consultation as onset, I'll explain the occasional symptoms and the scope of my notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a handover that distinguishes onset, consultation, and the scope of the record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を記録します。メモは診察で担当者にお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll record those details. Please show your notes to the medical staff during the consultation.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入場券を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you show me your admission ticket?

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この番号付きの券です。グッズを買う時に受け取りました。これで入れますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 物販整理券で入れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-02.translation: This numbered ticket. I received it when buying merchandise. Can I enter with it?
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a merchandise queue ticket permits admission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それは物販の整理券です。試合の入場券は別にお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is a merchandise queue ticket. Do you have a separate game admission ticket?

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 購入メールがあります。物販の番号を座席番号と思っていたので、メールから入場券を開きます。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 整理番号と座席を区別し入場券を開く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the purchase email. I thought the merchandise number was my seat number, so I'll open the admission ticket from the email.
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the queue number from the seat and open your admission ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 画面の日付と対戦するチームを確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the date and competing teams on the screen.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日の日付ですが、友人の分も同じメールにあります。二枚を順番に出せば二人入れますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人分の券が同じメールにあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's today's date, but my friend's ticket is in the same email too. If I show both in order, can we both enter?
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that tickets for both people are in the same email. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この券の扱いと同行者の入場方法を係員が確認します。友人はご一緒ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff will check how these tickets work and how your companion should enter. Is your friend with you?

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ駅です。自分の分だけ確認してもらい、友人の券を今ここで使用したことにはしないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不在の友人分を使用せず自分だけ確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-08.translation: They're still at the station. Please check only mine and don't treat my friend's ticket as having been used here now.
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check only your own ticket without using the absent friend's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人分を区別して確認します。友人の入場方法は、その券の案内を読んでお伝えください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll identify your ticket separately. Please read the instructions for your friend's ticket and tell them how to enter.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の入場券を提示し、友人には物販整理券では入れないことと本人の券の案内を伝えます。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の券を提示し友人へ券の違いと利用案内を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll present my admission ticket and tell my friend that the merchandise queue ticket doesn't permit entry and explain their own ticket's instructions.
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present your ticket and tell your friend the ticket distinction and usage guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご本人分の券を確認します。整理券は別に保管してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check your ticket. Please keep the queue ticket separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 返却についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about returning books?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家には二冊しかありませんが、この一覧には三冊あります。一冊なくしたと思って探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 履歴三冊と手元二冊の不一致を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only have two books at home, but this list shows three. I've been searching because I thought I'd lost one.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a mismatch between three books in the history and two in your possession. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの一覧を見ているか確認しましょう。これは貸出履歴の画面です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check which list you're viewing. This screen shows your borrowing history.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 現在借りている本だけの一覧だと思っていました。貸出中の画面はどこで見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 履歴と貸出中を区別し現在の画面を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it listed only the books I currently have on loan. Where can I see the current-loans screen?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish borrowing history from current loans and ask for the current screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらです。この画面の二冊と、お持ちの本を照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here it is. Please compare the two books on this screen with yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二冊とも一致しています。履歴のもう一冊には返却日がありますね。未返却とは申し出ないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現貸出二冊を照合し返却済みを紛失扱いしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Both match. The other book in the history has a return date, doesn't it? I won't report it as unreturned.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Match the two current loans and do not treat a returned book as lost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録の意味が分からなければ、窓口で確認できます。今日は二冊とも返しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the record's meaning is unclear, you can check at the counter. Will you return both today?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一冊はまだ読みたいです。二冊の状態が分かったので、返すのはこの一冊だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返す一冊と継続して読む一冊を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to keep reading one. Now that I know both books' status, I'll return only this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the book to return from the one you will keep reading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、その一冊の返却処理をします。残す本の期限は現在の貸出画面で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I'll process that one return. Check the due date of the book you keep on the current-loans screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。処理後に一覧を見直し、残る一冊と期限を確認します。履歴は現在の貸出数には数えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却処理後に残る一冊と期限を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. After processing, I'll review the list and confirm the one remaining book and its due date. I won't count the history as my current number of loans.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After the return is processed, check the remaining book and due date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一冊をお預かりします。処理が終わるまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take this one book. Please wait until processing is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日の会計はこちらで済みました。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この紙を会社へ出せば、健診結果を提出したことになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 領収書が健診結果の提出になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: If I submit this paper to my company, does that count as submitting my health-check results?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the receipt counts as submitting health-check results. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは費用の領収書です。結果の書類は、別に案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a receipt for the fee. We'll explain the results document separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会計の紙を結果だと思っていました。会社が求めるのは結果なので、受け取り方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 領収書と結果を区別し結果受取方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the payment paper was the results. My company requires the results, so I'd like to ask how to receive them.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the receipt from results and ask how to collect the results. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 結果の発行について担当が説明します。会社の提出案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will explain issuance of the results. Do you have your company's submission instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。提出先の指定書式があります。領収書をそこへ貼って代用せず、担当に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社の指定書式を示し領収書で代用しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. There's a form specified by the recipient. Rather than stick the receipt onto it as a substitute, I'll show it to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the company's specified form and do not substitute the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が書式と発行方法を確認します。発行時期も聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: They'll check the format and issuance method. Please ask about the issuance timing too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社の期限に間に合うかを自分で決めつけず、案内された発行時期を会社へ伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発行時期を確認して会社の期限を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than assume it will meet my company's deadline, I'll tell the company the issuance timing I'm given and discuss it with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check issuance timing and discuss the company deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 支払いに関する手続きと、結果書類の手続きは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check payment procedures separately from the results-document procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 領収書は自分の支払記録として保管します。結果の書式と時期を担当に確認してから提出を準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払記録を保管し結果の書式と時期を別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the receipt as my own payment record. I'll prepare the submission after checking the results format and timing with the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the payment record and separately check the results format and timing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、結果書類の担当へご案内します。会社の書式もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll guide you to the results-document staff. Bring the company's form too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの手続きですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: もう一度お風呂へ入りたいです。館内着を返却箱へ入れましたが、精算はまだです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再入浴希望と館内着返却済み精算前を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like another bath. I've put the facility clothing in the return box, but I haven't paid yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to bathe again, have returned the facility clothing, and have not settled the bill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 館内着を返した状態と、退館の手続きは分けて確認します。利用証はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the returned-clothing status separately from departure procedures. Do you have your usage pass?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持っています。服を返しただけで利用時間が終わったと思っていましたが、扱いを確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 利用証を示し返却と利用終了の関係を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought returning the clothes alone meant my usage time was over. Could you check how it's handled?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your usage pass and check the relationship between returning clothing and the end of your visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が今の利用状態と再入浴の条件を確認します。ご自身の服には着替えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check your current usage status and the conditions for bathing again. Have you changed into your own clothes?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。替えの館内着が当然もらえるとは考えず、必要な手順を聞いてから戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 着替え済みを報告し追加貸出しの手順を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I won't assume I'll automatically get another set of facility clothing. I'd like to hear the necessary steps before going back.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have changed and ask about additional clothing rental procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内前には浴室へ戻らず、こちらでお待ちください。追加の貸出しや料金も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait here without returning to the baths before the guidance. We'll check additional rentals and fees too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。返却箱の服を取り戻すこともしません。利用証を出してここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返却服を取り出さず案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't take the clothes back out of the return box either. I'll show my pass and wait here.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait for guidance without retrieving returned clothing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から再入浴と精算の説明をします。条件によっては、そのまま退館する選択もできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain bathing again and payment. Depending on the conditions, you may also choose to leave as you are.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いてから決めます。追加費用があるなら金額も確認し、戻るか退館するか伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加費用も含め説明後に再入浴か退館か決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll decide after the explanation. If there are extra costs, I'll check the amount too, then tell you whether I'll go back or leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide whether to bathe again or leave after hearing the explanation, including extra costs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現時点では退館処理を進めず、確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We won't proceed with departure processing at this stage; we'll check first.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような見学をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of visit would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大学の案内に一般公開とあります。学生の授業を途中から見学したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一般公開を通常授業の自由見学と思った希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The university information says ‘open to the public.’ I'd like to watch part of a regular student class after it has begun.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you interpreted public access as free observation of ordinary classes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何が一般公開されるかは、案内の内容を確認する必要があります。掲載された企画名は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check what the notice says is open to the public. Do you know the name of the listed event?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 公開講座と書いてあります。普段の授業を自由に見られる意味ではなかったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 公開講座と通常授業を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says ‘public lecture.’ So it didn't mean I could freely watch regular classes.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish a public lecture from regular classes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 公開講座への参加条件は、主催者の案内で確認してください。敷地の見学条件とも別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check participation conditions for the public lecture in the organizer's information. Those are also separate from conditions for visiting the grounds.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 講座は時間が合いません。建物の外観を見る希望へ変えたいので、入れる範囲を主催者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 講座に参加せず外観見学の範囲を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The lecture time doesn't work for me. I'd like to change my plan to viewing building exteriors, so I'll check the permitted area with the organizer.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not attend the lecture and ask to check the area allowed for viewing building exteriors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 公開講座の申込みをしても、ほかの建物へ入れるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even applying for the public lecture doesn't necessarily permit entry to other buildings.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見学のためだけに講座へ申し込むことはしません。外観を見る範囲が分かってから、周辺散策と組み合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見学目的だけの講座申込をせず散策計画を調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't apply for the lecture just to look around. Once I know the permitted exterior-viewing area, I'll combine it with a walk in the neighborhood.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid applying for a lecture solely to gain viewing access and adjust your walking plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 目的地は、講座会場ではなく見学可能な入口に合わせて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check your destination against an entrance you may use for visiting, rather than the lecture venue.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。主催者から見学範囲を聞き、入れる入口を確認してから行程を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 許可範囲と入口を確認して行程を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll ask the organizer about the permitted area and confirm the entrance I can use before deciding my itinerary.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the permitted area and entrance before deciding your itinerary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡先の載った案内をお渡しします。講座と見学の条件を分けてお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give you the information with the contact details. Please ask about lecture and visit conditions separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ラインの状態を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me the line's status.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画面に停止と出ています。部品が途中に残っているので、手で取れば再開できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 停止表示を見て内部の部品を取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The screen says ‘stopped.’ There are parts left halfway through. Can we restart if I remove them by hand?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Seeing a stopped display, ask whether you may remove internal parts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停止表示だけで、内部へ手を入れてよいとは判断しないでください。担当が状態と手順を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't assume the stopped display means you may put your hands inside. The person responsible will check the condition and procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ手は入れていません。停止表示が出たことと、部品が残って見えることを報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触と観察事実を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't put my hands in yet. I'm reporting that the stopped display appeared and that I can see parts remaining inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report that you have not touched it and state only what you observed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 操作盤にも触らず、担当を待ってください。いつからその状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't touch the control panel either; wait for the person responsible. Since when has it been this way?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 材料を入れた後からです。原因は分からないので、部品が詰まったと断定せず経過を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発生時点を伝え原因を推測で断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Since after I put the material in. I don't know the cause, so I'll explain the sequence without claiming a part is jammed.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the point when it occurred without asserting a guessed cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 周囲の人にも、確認前に操作しないよう知らせてください。復旧作業は指定担当が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell others nearby not to operate it before the check too. Recovery work is done by the designated person.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 隣の作業員に知らせます。自分の判断で停止を解除せず、指定担当に現状を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 周囲へ操作停止を知らせ指定担当に引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell the worker beside me. I won't release the stop myself and will explain the current state to the designated person.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell those nearby not to operate it and hand over to the designated person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 私が引き継ぎます。離れる必要がある時も、担当への引継ぎを済ませてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll take over. If you need to leave, make sure you've completed the handover to the person responsible too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。表示と発生時点を引き継ぎ、再開の指示が出るまでは材料の投入も止めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示と時点を引き継ぎ再開指示まで投入を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll hand over the display and the point it began, and stop feeding materials until instructed to resume.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the display and timing and stop input until restart instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのままお待ちください。確認が終わってから次の作業を指示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait as you are. We'll instruct you on the next task after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この区画の給餌は、個体の割当表を確認して進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Feeding in this enclosure proceeds after checking the individual allocation chart.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 表には五頭ですが、見えるのは四頭です。五頭分を四頭へ分ければよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記録五頭と目視四頭の違いと配分案を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The chart says five animals, but I can see four. Should I divide five animals' feed among the four?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the difference between five recorded animals and four visible ones and your allocation idea. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 頭数の違いを確認する前に、配分を変えないでください。今は給餌を始めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't change the allocation before checking the difference in numbers. Have you started feeding yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。一頭が見えないという観察で、移動したかどうかまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未給餌で不在理由は不明だと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. My observation is that I can't see one animal; I don't know whether it has been moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report that feeding has not started and the reason an animal is unseen is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 柵の外から確認できる個体識別と区画名を報告してください。中へ探しに入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Report the enclosure name and identification you can confirm from outside the fence. Don't enter to look for the animal.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見える四頭の番号と区画名を控えます。離れたところの一頭を、ここの五頭目だと数えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 柵外で番号を確認し別区画の個体と混同しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll note the four visible animals' numbers and enclosure name. I'll make sure not to count an animal farther away as this enclosure's fifth.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check numbers outside the fence and avoid confusing an animal in another enclosure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 私が当日の移動記録と照合します。飼料はほかの区画へ回さず、そのまま置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll compare them with today's movement record. Leave the feed as it is without reallocating it to another enclosure.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この区画用の飼料を分けた状態で残します。不足と思って追加することもせず、結果を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飼料を区画別に保ち追加配分をせず待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll keep this enclosure's feed separate. I won't add extra thinking there's a shortage either; I'll wait for the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep feed separate by enclosure and wait without adding or reallocating it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 照合が終わってから対象と配分を指示します。ほかの人に引き継ぐ時も確認前だと伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once the comparison is complete, we'll instruct you which animals and allocations apply. Tell anyone you hand over to that the check is still pending too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。四頭が見えた時点と番号を報告し、この区画は確認待ちで未給餌だと共有します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 観察時点と番号を報告し確認待ち未給餌を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll report the time I saw four and their numbers, and share that this enclosure is awaiting checking and hasn't been fed.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the observation time and numbers and share that feeding has not begun while awaiting checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その情報で確認します。指示が出るまでは配分を変えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check using that information. Don't change the allocation until instructed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 宛先の記入に抜けがないか、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check that nothing is missing from the destination address.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人も私と同じ建物なので、住所は一か所だけ書きました。部屋番号だけ追加すれば足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ建物の友人への宛先記入を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend lives in the same building as me, so I wrote the address only once. Is adding just their room number enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to address mail to a friend in the same building. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先と差出人は別の欄です。同じ建物でも、どちらの住所か分かるように記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The recipient and sender have separate fields. Even in the same building, write it so it's clear whose address it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今の欄は自分の差出人住所でした。そこへ友人の部屋番号を足さず、宛先欄へ友人の住所を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 差出人欄を修正せず別の宛先欄に記入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The field I filled in was my sender address. Rather than add my friend's room number there, I'll write their address in the destination field.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the sender field separate and enter the recipient in the destination field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ご自身の部屋番号も、ご自身の欄で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Also check your own room number in your own field.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分は二〇一、友人は三〇一です。似ているので、両方をそれぞれの名前と合わせて読み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自他の部屋番号と名前を組にして読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Mine is two hundred and one; my friend's is three hundred and one. They're similar, so I'll reread each number together with the appropriate name.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read back your own and your friend's room numbers paired with the respective names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人のお名前の表記も、本人に確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you also checked the correct spelling of your friend's name with them?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ略称しか知りません。受取人の正式な表記を確認してから記入を終えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取人名が未確認だと申告し本人に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only know a shortened name so far. I'll finish after checking the recipient's formal name.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the recipient name is unconfirmed and check with them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その確認ができてから、お持ちください。今は発送処理には進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please bring it after you've checked that. We can't proceed with mailing yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。ラベルを持ち帰り、二つの住所欄と受取人名を確認してから再度相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発送を保留し両住所欄と名前確認後に戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll take the label home and consult again after checking both address fields and the recipient's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold mailing and return after confirming both address fields and the name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、記入欄の案内をお渡しします。差出人の情報は宛先と混ぜないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll give you guidance on the fields. Please don't mix the sender's details with the destination.
